# Suspect apprehended by multiple agencies.

Hamilton County Sheriff Charmaine McGuffey, Lockland Police Chief James Toles, and Cincinnati Police Chief Eliot Isaac report that a suspect, identified as Dale Allen Smith III, Male, DOB 5/19/1998 pointed a gun at a Lockland police officer and the officer fired in response.
